calls.title: Customer Insights for Design Team
calls.summary: The discussion highlighted the customer onboarding process, emphasizing its variability depending on customer maturity, spanning from proof of concept (POC) to full adoption. Logan manages pre-customer POCs, while Chris supports developers post-signature, aiming for an onboarding timeline of around two months. The dynamics of feedback and support were outlined, with Chris delving into user issues and feature requests. It was noted that most customers prefer UI over API, creating an onboarding challenge related to the understanding of feature flags versus experiments. The conversation also acknowledged that product analytics adoption is still in early stages, with managed warehouses aiding analytics integration. The critical role of APIs in future automation was discussed, alongside the informal methods used to capture customer feedback in sales processes.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook onboarding, feature flags, experiments, API usage, product analytics, customer feedback
